axes.range_rationale: The retained 3.5 m source lane and 2.0 m diagnostic body width place the starting footprint 0.75 m inside each marking; the CPU source probe spans no excursion through 2.2 m rightward, while actual Native feasibility remains unverified.
axes.spacing_rationale: Three distinct setpoints 0.0, 1.1 and 2.2 m probe inside, just across and farther across the geometric marking without treating the boundary as a legal cutoff.
